verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that Stripe documents an official MCP server at docs.stripe.com/mcp, so the vendor ships first-party MCP connectivity for agents. However, the evidence is a single probe line and does not show that Radar-specific resources (reviews, rules, value lists, early fraud warnings) are exposed through it. Missing for 10: evidence that Radar tools or resources are served via the MCP server, setup/auth documentation details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
